description: Trace the redirect chain of a URL to its final destination without downloading page bodies: every hop with its status code, time and Location header, the final URL, whether the domain changed, and loop detection. Useful before trusting a short link or an ad link. Query: ?url=https://bit.ly/… — $0.005000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "where does this short link go", "unshorten this url", "follow redirects".
name: url_unwrap
